20 questions that reveal your unfair advantage.

Answer them tonight. Most people never ask.

YOUR CAREER

1. What do coworkers always ask you for help with?
2. What problem can you fix faster than anyone?
3. What did you learn the hard way that new hires still get wrong?
4. What results are you proud of?
5. Which part of your job would you teach for free?

YOUR LIFE

6. What's the hardest thing you've lived through and come out of?
7. What have you taught yourself with nobody paying you?
8. What do friends always come to you for?
9. What transformation have you made that others still want?
10. What can you talk about for an hour without notes?

YOUR EDGE

11. Which career skill and life experience could you combine?
12. What do you know now that you wish you knew 5 years ago?
13. What mistakes could you save someone from making?
14. What sounds obvious to you but isn't obvious to others?
15. What results can you prove?

YOUR MOVE

16. Which answer kept coming up?
17. What problem does it solve better than anything you'd learn from scratch?
18. What's one product you could make from it?
19. What would you post about it this week?
20. Will you use it, or start from zero again?

The 25-step exit from your 9-5.

Start in November. Get out before AI replaces you.

DISCOVER

1. Stop scrolling for the next business model.
2. List what your career taught you.
3. List what your life taught you.
4. Find where they overlap.
5. Pick one. That's your unfair advantage.

PRODUCT

6. Solve one specific problem with it.
7. Package it: ebook, guide or masterclass.
8. Keep it simple enough to finish in 2 weeks.
9. Price it. Free isn't a business.
10. Launch before it feels ready.

CONTENT

11. Teach one lesson from your experience every day.
12. Speak to who you were 5 years ago.
13. Reply more than you post.
14. Point every post to your product.
15. Track buyers, not views.

BUSINESS

16. Turn your first buyers into proof.
17. Add a bigger offer for people who want more.
18. Reinvest before you upgrade your lifestyle.
19. Know the number that replaces your salary.
20. Build until the business can carry you.

EXIT

21. Savings and no dependents? Go all in.
22. Need the paycheck? Build alongside the job.
23. Either way, set a date.
24. Leave when the business holds weight.
25. Do step 1 today. Not Monday.
